download_bart_model: download the pretrained BART large model from fairseq and convert it to ParlAI format
run_conversion_script: run the ConversionScript.main to convert fairseq BART model weights to ParlAI format
configure_conversion_args: configure the CONVERSION_ARGS dictionary with tokenizer, activation, and fp16 settings for BART conversion
configure_bart_args: configure the BART_ARGS dictionary with model hyperparameters like embedding size, layers, and dropout
check_bart_model_built: check if the BART model has already been built using build_data.built with a version string
